newsitem.title: USA: Company gets early nod for Sugarbush, Vt., hotel.
newsitem.headline: Company gets early nod for Sugarbush, Vt., hotel.

text.p: American Skiing Co moved one step closer to building a giant slope-side hotel and conference center at the Sugarbush ski area in Warren.
Warren Planning Commission has given tentative approval to the 153,000-square-foot project planned for the Lincoln Peak base area.

The commission rejected an earlier proposal over concerns about traffic, financing, and a small trout stream on the site. The company has altered the plans and moved the projects site to avoid the stream.
The next step is to present final plans to the commission. The company hopes to begin construction on the project this year.
